name: typing-pause
description: Plan 2026-10-14 A4: keys typed in a burst, each followed by the semantic tokens request an editor sends after an edit. clangd is given every version without wanting its diagnostics, and builds the file once the typing pauses: no diagnostics are published while the keys come, the latest version's arrive within a few seconds of the last one, and the token requests are answered once, for the latest text -- the ones a later key replaced as content modified.
